target.title: feat(browser): normalize ChatGPT Work sessions to Chat
target.body:
Closes #315.

## Motivation

ChatGPT now exposes separate `Chat` and `Work` modes. Both render a usable composer, so `ensurePromptReady` alone cannot tell whether a new Oracle browser run is about to perform ordinary Chat model/effort selection in the Work UI.

This is a standalone browser compatibility enhancement. It is independent of GPT-5.6 model aliases and picker behavior, and distinct from #308's Cloudflare classification fix.

## Design

- Probe the exact visible `Chat` / `Work` radio controls before model or effort selection.
- Switch Work to Chat through trusted CDP mouse input, verify the selected state, and re-wait for the replacement composer.
- Classify attached conversation tabs after their active history metadata hydrates.
- Aggregate every same-origin history-link instance for the exact conversation ID, covering root `/c/<id>` and project-scoped `/g/.../c/<id>` URLs as well as responsive sidebar duplicates.
- Treat only ChatGPT's structured, renderer-owned `Work` badge as authoritative; free-form conversation titles can never trigger a reset or reject a resume.
- Treat a terminal aria `, Work` suffix only as bounded hydration evidence. Persistent aria-only ambiguity preserves compatibility without authorizing a destructive action.
- Reset a non-resume Work attachment to a new Chat while preserving the configured project/workspace URL.
- Fail closed for an explicit resume of a confirmed Work conversation instead of silently abandoning the requested thread.
- Allocate a fresh verification window after any Work-to-Chat click or navigation and require positive Chat evidence before prompt submission.
- Preserve compatibility with older layouts when Chat/Work controls and metadata are absent before Oracle changes page state.
- Apply the same normalization to local and remote-Chrome browser paths.

Rebased onto current `main` at `575e0881`, including the merged GPT-5.6 integration from #314.

## Validation

Current head: `eb22ee250823000910ea821cb2bae7c899907c01`.

- `pnpm vitest run tests/browser/pageActions.test.ts tests/browser/index.test.ts` — 147 passed, 1 skipped.
- `pnpm check` — passed.
- `pnpm build` — passed.
- `env -u ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL PATH=[temporary-rsync]:$PATH pnpm test` — 1,554 passed, 44 skipped. The temporary `rsync` binary was unpacked under `/tmp`; the repository and system installation were not modified.
- GitHub CI on the current head — Ubuntu, macOS, Windows, and GitGuardian passed.

The behavior-level regression matrix covers comma-containing and exact-`Work` titles, arbitrary exact-text descendants, malformed badge near misses, aria-only ambiguity, delayed hydration, root/project URLs, duplicate history items, cross-origin lookalikes, explicit resume rejection, non-resume reset, and post-action verification.

## Inspectable exact-head live-browser evidence

Validated against commit `eb22ee250823000910ea821cb2bae7c899907c01` using a signed-in AdsPower browser profile.

No run clicked or auto-clicked ChatGPT's "Answer now" control. Profile identifiers, target IDs, local paths, ports, authentication data, and conversation URLs are redacted.

### Ordinary Chat title collision

Live DOM precondition:

```text
aria-label: Plan, Work, and travel
structured Work badges: 0
```

```sh
pnpm start -- --engine browser --browser-attach-running \
  --remote-chrome [redacted-host:port] --browser-tab [redacted-target] \
  --browser-model-strategy current --browser-archive never --timeout 5m \
  --verbose -p "Reply exactly PR316_TITLE_COLLISION_OK."
```

```text
Attached to existing remote ChatGPT tab [redacted] ([redacted conversation URL])
Login check passed (...)
ChatGPT mode: Chat
Prompt textarea ready (initial focus, 39 chars queued)
Clicked send button
[browser] conversation url (post-submit) = [redacted conversation URL]
Remote session complete • 10.3s total
Answer:
PR316_TITLE_COLLISION_OK
```

The conversation remained attached; Oracle did not navigate away or invoke the Work reset path.

### Structured Work badge

Live DOM precondition:

```text
aria-label: [redacted title], Work
badge tag: SPAN
badge text: Work
badge class includes: shrink-0
badge dir: null
badge childElementCount: 0
badge parent: span.flex.items-center
```

```sh
pnpm start -- --engine browser --browser-attach-running \
  --remote-chrome [redacted-host:port] --browser-tab [redacted-target] \
  --browser-model-strategy current --browser-archive never --timeout 5m \
  --verbose -p "Reply exactly PR316_STRUCTURED_WORK_OK."
```

```text
Attached to existing remote ChatGPT tab [redacted] ([redacted Work conversation URL])
Login check passed (...)
ChatGPT mode: Work conversation; opening a new Chat
Navigating to https://chatgpt.com/
ChatGPT mode: Chat (switched from Work)
Prompt textarea ready (initial focus, 39 chars queued)
Clicked send button
[browser] conversation url (post-submit) = [redacted new Chat URL]
Remote session complete • 13.5s total
Answer:
PR316_STRUCTURED_WORK_OK
```
